insights.one_liner: Nexent Bank is an Amsterdam-licensed bank focused on emerging markets, owned by Turkey's Fiba Group, with a strongly international, Turkish-rooted workforce.

culture.text: Many staff come from Turkish and Romanian universities such as Boğaziçi, Istanbul Technical University and Middle East Technical University.
People mostly studied economics, business, computer engineering and finance, and work in finance, sales, IT and business development.
It says it has around 900 employees in 7 countries and lists dynamism, diversity and expertise as core values.
Work covers corporate banking, trade and commodity finance, supply chain finance and marine finance.

open.text: Nexent Bank N.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, a senior compliance role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Founded in Amsterdam on 24 February 1994, it serves more than 400,000 retail and corporate customers worldwide.

worth_knowing.text: It is owned by Turkish holding company Fiba Group.
